map.输入事故年的终极赔款估计与当前已付比例，按 IBNR = 终极赔款 × (1 −: Enter the estimated ultimate losses for the accident year and the current paid ratio, and estimate the incurred but not reported reserve as IBNR = ultimate losses x (1 - paid ratio); used by property and casualty insurers to assess outstanding claim liabilities.

map.做准备金充足性快速校验。: A quick check of reserve adequacy.

map.已付比例高说明什么？: What does a high paid ratio mean?
map.已付 70% 说明理赔较成熟，IBNR 仅剩 30%；早期业务已付低 IBNR: A 70% paid ratio means the claims are fairly mature and only 30% IBNR remains; for early business the paid ratio is low, IBNR is a large share, and uncertainty is high.
map.用已付比例估 IBNR 会低估吗？: Does estimating IBNR from the paid ratio underestimate it?
map.会。已付比例高仅代表钱付得快，未报案案件（reporting lag）仍可能大量: Yes. A high paid ratio only means money was paid quickly; unreported claims (reporting lag) may still be numerous. A more robust approach uses the reported ratio or the chain-ladder method to estimate IBNR and reported-but-unpaid at the same time.
